metadata.title: Common Shade — stakeholder landscape
metadata.review_type: Structured rapid evidence map; not an exhaustive systematic review, organisation ranking or legal/operational due-diligence audit.
metadata.geography_definition: countries are verified heat-work/project geographies, not headquarters or funding eligibility. Regional work is not proof of a domestic delivery footprint. Empty country arrays mean no specific country established by cited evidence.
metadata.counting_unit: Organisation, public institution, or explicitly identified coordination network; most hosted programmes/subsidiaries grouped with parent. GHHIN and Cool Coalition shown separately as distinct network functions, with hosts identified.
metadata.facts_vs_inference: does, evidence and sourced collaborations report published activity; taxonomy, could_contribute and bridge/entry suggestions are researcher interpretation.
metadata.counts_do_not_mean: Programme impact, causal interruption of a loop, current funding access, endorsement or willingness to collaborate.
metadata.taxonomy_note: Supplied Block 0 IDs retained; live site showed 18 loops and 26 levers, so reconcile schemas before import.
limitations: Some records establish consultation, partner membership, issued guidance or planned pilots rather than implementation. Stage and limitations fields distinguish these.
Historical sources do not establish current product availability or legal/corporate continuity.
All primary claim sources were retrieved for content; review depth is stated. Automated HTTP availability is a separate check and may encounter access controls.
Researcher-made geographical and functional classifications require local confirmation before public use.
